evidence.port_deviation_reason: Vite dev server (PID 69412) is serving stale modules — shows the OLD stub AgentsView ("Module pending") not the new feature module. Static dist on 1421 renders correctly.

defects_observed.title: Legend (.ag-railfoot) has no CSS
defects_observed.detail: AgentRail.tsx renders <div className='ag-railfoot'> with 5 <span> items, but agents.css has no rule for .ag-railfoot. Computed style: display:block, gap:normal, padding:0px — legend items run together with 0 spacing. Compare to .inbox__legend (inbox.css) which uses display:flex;gap:15px;padding:13px 16px. Inconsistent with the design system's pattern.
defects_observed.evidence: Computed style via playwright: {display:'block', gap:'normal', padding:'0px'}

defects_observed.title: Unread sidebar badge won't decrement when messages are marked read in the Agents view
defects_observed.detail: UnreadProvider subscribes only to agent_message (increment) and agent_list (refresh). When the Agents view's markAgentRead() / markRead() / markAllRead() updates local state, the provider doesn't refresh. In a live daemon environment this means the badge will keep accumulating unread and never decrement as the user reads. Cross-view sync is limited because the IPC contract has no 'message_read' event. Out of contract scope but a real UX bug introduced with the badge.
defects_observed.evidence: src/ipc/unread.tsx:29-35 only handles agent_message and agent_list; useAgents does not call any provider refresh hook (the hook only exposes count, no refresh).

defects_observed.title: Smoke tested on port 1421 (static dist) instead of protocol-required port 1420 (dev)
defects_observed.detail: Protocol specified browser smoke via `npm run dev` on port 1420. Worker ran curl on 1420 (200 OK) but visually smoke-tested 1421 (python -m http.server dist). Justified — Vite dev server (PID 69412) is serving stale modules, showing the OLD stub view ("Module pending", "No agents attached"). Static dist shows the new code correctly. Defensible workaround but a protocol deviation.
defects_observed.evidence: Playwright on port 1420 shows Agents nav active but main element renders the OLD stub ('Module pending' badge, 'No agents attached' title). Playwright on port 1421 renders the new component correctly.
